name: xr3_afteryou_sub
purpose: After You targeting an ally that holds a Substitute (bypasssub: After You's flags carry bypasssub, data/moves.ts:195-218): Indeedee (M) prioritizes the queued Iron Head of Aggron (M), whose sub stays up. Turn 1 Aggron raises the sub, turn 2 After You targets Aggron (-activate After You on the ally) and Aggron's Iron Head goes next; no sub line on the After You. Primarina (F) and Milotic (F) hit Indeedee on turn 2.
